summary: Addresses the gap in GMPLS and MPLS-TE networks between completing LSP signaling and the cross-connection actually being programmed. It defines ways to report data path delay for a Label Switched Path. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Finishing the paperwork for a road does not mean it is ready for cars. This memo helps report how long until the road works.

questions: gmpls signaling versus data plane readiness
